questions.question:
Parts of the given sentence have been underlined. One of them contains an error. The underlined parts are given as options with some changes. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

__Raveena’s daughter__ Kavya is __most intelligent__ student and __she consistently__ achieves __top grades.__
questions.solution:

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**an**" before the term "**intelligent**."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article **("a" or "an").**

• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Raveena’s daughter Kavya is **an intelligent** student and she consistently achieves top grades."*

then, 23 June 2020 will be Monday + 1 = Tuesday.

Total profit = 66.671%

**∴ The net gain percentage is 66.67% (rounded off to 2 decimal places).**

questions.question: A constellation of the northern sky easily recognised by a group of five bright stars forming a slightly irregular ‘W’ is called:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cassiopeia**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cassiopeia A is a **supernova** remnant.
 
• It is notable for being the brightest astronomical radio source in the sky.
 
• It is the strongest radio source in the sky outside the solar system and was one of the first radio sources to be discovered, in** 1947**.
 
• The five brightest stars of Cassiopeia – **Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, and Epsilon Cassiopeiae **– form the characteristic** W-shaped** asterism.
 
• Its brightest star is Alpha Cassiopeiae or **Shedar (Arabic for “breast”).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Informatio__**

 
• **Cygnus**

 
 
• Cygnus X-1, denoted as Cyg X-1, stands as a celestial marvel in the constellation Cygnus, recognized as the first galactic X-ray source widely acknowledged as a black hole. .
 
• Its discovery in 1971 marked a pivotal moment in astrophysics, and since then, it has continued to captivate researchers worldwide.
 
• It boasts a remarkable **X-ray flux density, reaching 2.3×10⁻²³ W/(m²⋅Hz) or 2.3×10³ jansky.**
 
• Cygnus is non-reusable and is designed to burn up upon re-entry into Earth's atmosphere after delivering cargo to the ISS.
 
 
 
• **Orion**
 
 
• Orion constellation is one of the **brightest and best-known constellations in the night sky**.
 
• It lies on the celestial equator.
 
• Orion has been known since ancient times.
 
• The constellation is** also known as the Hunter,** as it is associated with one in Greek mythology.
 
• It represents the mythical hunter Orion, who is often depicted in star maps as either facing the charge of Taurus, the bull. 
 
 
 
• **Ursa Major**
 
 
• The name "**;Ursa Major"** is Latin for "**Greater Bear,**" and its mythology can be traced back to several ancient cultures.
 
• In Greek mythology, Ursa Major is associated with the nymph **Callisto**, who was transformed into a bear and placed in the sky by Zeus.
 
• Ursa Major has been recognized and represented in various ways by different cultures, including** Native American, Hindu, and Chinese traditions.**
 
• The constellation is part of the family of constellations that includes **Ursa Minor, Draco, and Boötes.**
 
• Stars in Ursa Major are relatively close to Earth, and some of them are part of the Ursa Major Moving Group, a **cluster of stars **that share a common motion through space.

questions.question: On 2 March 2023, the Supreme Court delivered an order on appointments to the Election Commission. According to this order, appointments will be done under the recommendation of a committee having which of the following members?

options.text: Prime Minister, Chief Justice of India and Speaker of the Lok Sabha
Prime Minister, Leader of the opposition and Speaker of the Lok Sabha
Prime Minister, Leader of the opposition and Chief Justice of India
Prime Minister, Leader of the opposition and Chairman Rajya Sabha

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prime Minister, Leader of the opposition and Chief Justice of India**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Appointments to the Election Commission will be made by a panel of the** Prime Minister, Leader of the Opposition ( leader of the largest opposition party), and Chief Justice of India.**
 
• The court emphasized the need for an** impartial and independent Election Commission,** free from executive interference, ensuring that the process of appointments is more transparent.
 
• The judgment was aimed at strengthening the democratic framework by ensuring that those appointed to the Election Commission are unbiased and capable of** conducting free and fair elections.**
 
• This ruling is to be followed until Parliament enacts a law that provides a specific procedure for the appointment of Election Commissioners.
 
• The decision marked a significant moment in ensuring institutional integrity, drawing comparisons with similar reforms in other independent institutions like the **Central Vigilance Commission (CVC)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Election Commission of India is an **autonomous Constitutional Body** responsible for administering **Union and State election** processes in India
 
• The Election Commission of India came into force on** 25th January 1950.**
 
• **Article 324** of the Indian constitution mandates the Election Commission, to conduct elections to the **Parliament and the State Legislatures.**
 
• The Election Commission consists of a **Chief Election Commissioner and two Election Commissioners**.
 
• The **President appoints** Chief Election Commissioner and Election Commissioners.
 
• The body administers elections to the **Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and State Legislative Assemblies **in India, and the offices of the** President and Vice President** in the country.
 
• The secretariat of the commission is located in New Delhi.
 
• They have a fixed tenure of **six years, or up to the age of 65 years**, whichever is earlier.
 
• They enjoy the same status and receive salary and perks as available to Judges of the Supreme Court of India.
 
• The **Chief Election Commissioner **can be removed from office only through a process of** removal similar to that of a Supreme Court judge for by Parliament.**

questions.question: In which year was the National Human Rights Commission established in India?

• Its main purpose is to protect and promote human rights, including** civil, political, economic, social, and cultural rights** guaranteed by the Constitution and international treaties.
 
• The NHRC consists of a **chairperson (who is a retired Chief Justice of India)**, members of the judiciary, human rights experts, and representatives of minorities and marginalized groups.
 
• The NHRC investigates violations of human rights, recommends actions to the government, conducts awareness programs, and a**dvises on laws and policies** related to human rights.
